limits: Seven samples are not continuous full-video watching
UI seconds are not exact frame DOM times
Protection switches do not prove every fine boundary is protected
A tool entrance is not execution
Face degree2 config plus a layer does not prove completion of that specific generation
Generated cleanup and redraw are not traditional local PS D&B
Current author parameters are not user defaults
